sentence_stem: The court upheld the verdict, since
correct_completion: the evidence presented at trial was sufficient to support the conviction.
full_sentence: The court upheld the verdict, since the evidence presented at trial was sufficient to support the conviction.
acceptable_variants: the trial evidence adequately supported the guilty finding.
the material produced in court justified the conviction.

options.text: the defendant had requested a new trial.
options.why_wrong: A request for a new trial would not explain why the verdict was upheld, since the clause needs a reason for upholding it.

options.text: the prosecution had never presented any witnesses.
options.why_wrong: This contradicts the sufficiency of evidence that the 'since' clause needs to justify the verdict.

options.text: the evidence presented at trial was sufficient to support the conviction.
the courtroom was located on the third floor.
options.why_wrong: The location of the courtroom is irrelevant to the reason for upholding the verdict.

grammar_focus: Causal clause introduced by 'since' giving the reason for upholding a verdict
explanation: 'Since' introduces the reason the court upheld the verdict. Sufficient evidence at trial is the standard justification for maintaining a conviction.
translation: ፍርድ ቤቱ ብይኑን ያፀናው በችሎቱ የቀረበው ማስረጃ ጥፋተኛነቱን ለማረጋገጥ በቂ ስለነበረ ነው።
